description: Import a backup file from Object Storage as an imported backup (POST /mysql/v1/imported-backups → 202 Operation; up to 16 TiB). Then restore it with ncloud_serverless_restore_cluster (source.type=IMPORTED_BACKUP). Use dryRun=true to preview.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without importing

engineVersion.description: Engine version the backup was created with

objectPath.description: Backup file path inside the bucket (e.g. exports/backup.tar.gz)

zoneCode.description: Zone to store it in (default: first available zone, e.g. KR-2)

name: ncloud_serverless_create_imported_backup
